The '''Kruth Brothers Gang''' was a gang of criminals active during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Mission" /> Around [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|2.0}} As the Crew Skill mission "Rich History" was released with ''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'', it must also take place around that year.</ref> they sought to purchase fresh access codes to the [[Alderaan Historical Exhibit]], which at the [[Time/Legends|time]] was on loan to<ref name="Mission" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]].<ref name="Mission" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual associated with one of the two [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] powers sent a companion to acquire the access codes and sell them to the Kruth Brothers Gang.<ref name="Mission" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Kurth Brothers Gang was mentioned in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], a [[2013]] Digital Expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Mission" />
